correctness.rationale: The barycentric orbit-complex lemma identifies geometric fixed points exactly, not merely their homology. The Cayley adjacency criterion is exact. The support-count bound excludes ranks at least four. Rank-three support five is excluded by an elementary intersecting-edge argument; support-four hyperplanes and rank-two weight types are exhaustively classified. Explicit independent Cayley generators establish cube graphs; the exceptional quotient gives disjoint four-cycles. All boundary cases, including \(n=2\), are covered. A direct finite checker verified 3098 rank-two to rank-four subgroups for \(n\leq6\), 420 admissible, and triangle-free graph models; these finite checks corroborate rather than prove the unbounded result.

value.rationale: This classifies every higher-rank translation subgroup fixed geometric space in the first nontrivial mixed-dimensional scale-three hypercube Rips family. It shows that most admissible rank-two codes produce exactly a cube graph, while the support-four \(\{2,3,3\}\) code produces exponentially many separate circles, rank three produces isolated points and larger ranks have no fixed points. These structural bifurcations are invisible in ambient homotopy and homology characters, and the result provides explicit geometric models for subgroup-fixed topology across an infinite natural family.
